drafts.title: Aquarium Deep Systems Sprint
requirements: Produce between 10 and 14 implementation tasks total.
Assign every implementation task to aquarium-agent only.
Do not create tasks for adventure-agent, action-agent, or reviewer.
Keep every task scoped to files under src/barebones-starter/games/apps/aquarium/ only.
Tasks must be atomic enough to land as one commit each on the shared aquarium lane branch.
The resulting implementation should feel like one large aquarium sprint rather than isolated note files.
Cover gameplay depth across progression, fish behavior, economy pressure, threats, and presentation.
The reviewer should merge one aquarium PR after the lane finishes all tasks.
